title: Allora Cottage | KEY.co
description_expanded: Step onto the second-floor terrace through a private entrance and discover an outdoor dining space and a natural gas Weber grill, perfect for entertaining on pleasant evenings. Inside, the main living room features an expansive 82" 4K smart TV with 4K Apple TV, a Blu-Ray player, and a Sonos surround sound system. A wet bar with an ice maker is also available for your convenience. The second floor also boasts a gourmet kitchen equipped with a Viking gas stove, microwave, dishwasher, and Northland fridge and freezer. Additional small appliances ensure you have everything you need to create memorable meals. The dining room, furnished with a reclaimed elm-wood table, queen Murphy bed, and Sonos music system, provides an inviting atmosphere for shared meals. French doors lead to a front terrace overlooking Ruskin Park and the enchanting Fairy Forest. The kitchen is a culinary haven, equipped with new stainless steel appliances, stone countertops, and a range of small appliances. Whether you're preparing meals or enjoying snacks, the kitchen has everything you need. A breakfast bar provides additional seating for meals. In the living room, you'll find a 60" smart TV, a Blu-Ray player, and wireless internet. The queen-sized sleeper sofa beckons you to relax and unwind. Open the living room doors to a front patio furnished with Adirondack chairs, where you can enjoy the serene park view. An outdoor shower is conveniently located for rinsing off after a day at the beach.

Features: Fi Seaside private residential beach access

all: Fi Seaside private residential beach access

location.address: Introducing a remarkable vacation home nestled in Ruskin Park, in the heart of Seaside, FL. This home is the perfect choice for your family getaway or a relaxing beach retreat with friends. This three-story townhome offers luxurious comfort and accommodates up to 12 people across four bedrooms and five full baths. Each of the three king-sized master bedrooms features an en suite bath, ensuring privacy and convenience. Additionally, there is a room with bunk beds, a queen-sized Murphy bed, and a queen sofa bed for flexible sleeping arrangements.
